description: This file defines the uWS::TemplatedApp class template for creating web server applications with WebSocket and HTTP support, including server name management, route handling, WebSocket behavior configuration, and socket lifecycle management.

classes.name: uWS::TemplatedApp
classes.description: A template class for creating server applications supporting HTTP and WebSocket protocols with optional SSL.

classes.name: uWS::WebSocketBehavior
classes.description: Configuration structure for WebSocket connection behavior.

classes.name: uWS::SocketContextOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for socket context including SSL certificate files and preferences.

methods.name: addServerName
methods.description: Adds a server name (SNI) to the server context.

methods.name: removeServerName
methods.description: Removes a server name (SNI) from the server context.

methods.name: missingServerName
methods.description: Sets a handler for missing server names.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to all WebSocket subscribers on a topic.

methods.name: numSubscribers
methods.description: Returns the number of subscribers for a given topic.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all sockets and listen sockets.

methods.name: ws
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket route with specified behavior.

methods.name: domain
methods.description: Browses to a specific server name (SNI), changing the router context.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Registers a handler for all HTTP methods.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening on specified host and port.

methods.name: preOpen
methods.description: Registers a handler for pre-open socket events.

methods.name: addChildApp
methods.description: Adds a child application for load distribution.
